name: Cyprus Comic Con
blurb: Nicosia's largest pop-culture weekend, held at the Cyprus State Fair with international actors, voice actors, comic artists, cosplayers and musicians.
notes: The 2026 edition just concluded 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-04 (JSON-LD + on-site schedule), ending the day before this window opens, so it is not listed. A WebSearch for a 2027 Nicosia date found none; Cyprus Comic Con's own event calendar currently lists only its sister/licensed shows abroad for 2027 (Thessaloniki Comic Con, Aniventure Comic Con/Sofia), not a Nicosia date of its own. The just-finished 2026 lineup was substantial — around 30 actors, voice actors, artists, cosplayers and musicians on /special-guests/, including the Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 voice cast (Kirsty Rider, Rich Keeble, Maxence Cazorla) and several One Piece live-action actors (Callum Kerr, Vincent Regan) — but is not recorded here since no edition within the window exists to attach it to.
